description: Live monitoring dashboard for the VISTA C++ sensor-processing application. Data is received through Grafana Live channels published by grafana_bridge.

options.content:
This dashboard listens to Grafana Live channels under `stream/vista/...`. The C++ `grafana_bridge` worker publishes one measurement per data domain. Point-cloud panels intentionally display operational summaries rather than transmitting every XYZ point to Grafana. The channel prefix must match `GrafanaNamespace: vista` in `DeviceConfig.txt`.

IMU panels subscribe to `stream/vista/imu`; the LiDAR decoder publishes quaternion, angular velocity and linear acceleration through `lidar/imu`.

panels.title: LiDAR Online
panels.description: Latest online state published with the processed point-cloud measurement.

panels.title: Latest Point-cloud Bounds
panels.description: Axis-aligned bounds of the latest processed point cloud, in metres.

panels.title: IMU Online
panels.description: Latest IMU state published by the LiDAR decode worker.

panels.title: Radar Targets
panels.description: Reserved for the future radar worker.

panels.title: Detected Objects
panels.description: Reserved for the future detection worker.

panels.title: Active Tracks
panels.description: Reserved for the future tracking worker.

panels.title: Maximum Object Speed
panels.description: Reserved for the future tracking worker.

panels.title: Pipeline Health
panels.description: RAW, decoded and processed rates; end-to-end latency; queue usage; dropped messages; and age of the last LiDAR message.

panels.title: Worker Health
panels.description: One stream per worker with running state, failure state, configured priority and uptime.

panels.title: Grafana Bridge Health
panels.description: Delivery totals, HTTP status, retry state, age of the last successful push and number of subscribed topics.

panels.title: Storage Health
panels.description: Free disk space and cumulative RAW/PCD logger output counters.

panels.title: Power and Thermal
panels.description: CPU/GPU temperatures, detected board power and fan speed. The available field is zero when the operating system exposes none of these sensors.

panels.title: System Health - Full Fields
panels.description: Complete heartbeat including uptime, CPU, process memory, system memory percentage, running workers and failed workers.

panels.title: Live 3D Point Cloud with Ground Plane
panels.description: The translucent plane and normal arrow are generated from preprocessing ground diagnostics in the LPC1 WebSocket header.

panels.title: Ground Calibration Quality History
panels.description: Low and stable tilt, height error and residuals indicate a stable ground model.

panels.title: Latest Ground Model - Full Fields
panels.description: Plane ax+by+cz+d=0, calibration counters, inlier quality, point-removal counts and IMU/fallback flags.
